lines.en: I am faster than you, by a lot.

lines.zh: 我瘦长的身子一步跨两格。
lines.en: My thin body covers two blocks a stride.

lines.zh: 我绕过墙，走得像没有骨头。
lines.en: I round the wall as if I had no bones.

lines.zh: 我一来一回，你只看见影子。
lines.en: I come and go, and you see only a blur.

lines.zh: 我的步子没有声音，却很快。
lines.en: My steps are silent but quick.
I slide across the ground.

lines.zh: 我从走廊一头到另一头。
lines.en: I cross from one end of the corridor to the other.

lines.zh: 我弯着腰走，头几乎朝下。
lines.en: I walk bent double, head almost downward.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，速度一直在加。
lines.en: I circle you, and my speed keeps climbing.

lines.zh: 你听见的是我早就不在的位置。
lines.en: What you hear is where I was, not where I am.
I stop and my head tips to one side.
I stand, and my limbs are a little too long.

lines.zh: 我不动，盯着你背后的方向。
lines.en: I hold still, staring past you.
My body is thin as a line.
I am at the corner, almost invisible.
I turn my neck around slowly.

lines.zh: 我没有呼吸，也没有心跳。
lines.en: I have no breath and no heartbeat.
I stand, waiting for your first move.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身体宽。
lines.en: My shadow is wider than my body.
I am motionless and very patient.
My hands hang below my knees.
I go eerily still.
My head is lower than before.
I am listening to your pulse.

lines.zh: 我把自己折成不合适的样子。
lines.en: I fold myself into an unsuitable shape.

lines.zh: 我等得很久，也不觉得久。
lines.en: I wait a long time and it does not feel long.
You turn, and I am in front of you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你看，很快地靠近。
lines.en: I stare at you and close in fast.
You cannot make out what I am.

lines.zh: 你的速度，我早就知道了。
lines.en: I already know your speed.
I always arrive before you.
Lean and quick — you can't shake me.
I bring my face down to your height.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在动，位置不对。
lines.en: My eyes move, and the placement is wrong.

lines.zh: 你身上每块肌肉都绷着。
lines.en: Every muscle in you is tight.

lines.zh: 我看见你在数我出现的位置。
lines.en: I see you counting the places I appear.
How long can you run? I never tire.
I raise my hand faster than you react.
You look back, and I am on the other side.
I hear you swallow.

lines.zh: 你走得比我慢，就是这样。
lines.en: You are slower than me; that is all.
I warp, then straighten at once.
You hit me and I retreat fast.

lines.zh: 我的身体折了一下，又展开。
lines.en: My body folds, then unfolds.
You hit me; my head tilted.

lines.zh: 我发出一种很细的声音。
lines.en: I make a very thin sound.
I folded, then straightened again.
You are a little faster than I thought.
I retreat into the dark and look again.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，像在重新计算。
lines.en: I tilt my head, recalculating.

lines.zh: 这一下，你把距离拉近了。
lines.en: That blow closed the distance.
I'm thin down to a single layer of skin.
That little light, I go around it.
You run for the door, and I am there.
The weapon in your hand is too slow.

lines.zh: 你越喘，我越确定你在哪。
lines.en: The harder you breathe, the surer I am.
I can guess your route.
A torch will not hold me back.

lines.zh: 你躲在箱子后面，我先到了。
lines.en: You hide behind the chest; I am already there.
You want to call the others; there is no time.

lines.zh: 你身上所有出口，我都看着。
lines.en: I am watching every way out of you.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，你快站不稳了。
lines.en: I crash into you and you nearly fall.
My impact sends you far back.
I brush your shoulder, and it is cold.
You slam into me and cannot move.
My arms wrap around, quickly.

lines.zh: 我被你顶开，又立刻回来。
lines.en: You shove me off and I am back at once.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我的身体一点也不软。
lines.en: At the impact, my body is not soft at all.
The hit sends you off course.

lines.zh: 我挡在你面前，你撞了上去。
lines.en: I stand in your way and you run into me.
After we part, you are still shaking.

lines.zh: 我是追猎的东西，不是伴侣。
lines.en: I am a hunter, not a companion.
I only go forward; I do not look back.
Such a pause means nothing.
I only want to know how fast you run.
I do not answer; I pursue.
I only chase; I don't answer that.

lines.zh: 我的动作不会为这个停。
lines.en: My motion does not stop for that.
I tilt my head and walk on.
That is not among the things I do.
I turn away, very fast.
I pick it up and throw it in front of you.
I have no use for your things.
I snatch it up and let go.
It lies on the ground, and I do not look.

lines.zh: 我用脚踢开挡路的东西。
lines.en: I kick aside what is in my way.

lines.zh: 你的东西在我指间碎了。
lines.en: Your thing crumbled between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我拿着它跑了两步，又丢下。
lines.en: I run two steps with it, then drop it.

lines.zh: 这东西太慢了，你自己收着。
lines.en: This is too slow; you keep it.
I take it while watching you.
I hang it behind your back.

lines.zh: 这次换我主动，你别背对我。
lines.en: This time I make the move. Don't turn away.
I have your position.
I have you locked, tightly.
Run, and I will follow.
I want to see how far you get.
This target I will not give up.
I lift a foot, and it points at you.
You have been chosen.
My strides grow longer.
Catching you is only a matter of time.
I walk the way you came from.
Your scent lies along this path.
I lift my foot; it points only at you.
Once locked, I do not change.

lines.zh: 你转身之前，我已经在跑。
lines.en: I am already running before you turn.
This distance will only shorten.
Once I see you, I will not lose you.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里只是一个速度。
lines.en: To me you are only a speed.

lines.zh: 我在你侧面，比刚才更近。
lines.en: I am at your side, nearer than before.
You look back, and I slip behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我比你快，所以我慢慢走。
lines.en: I am faster, so I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我提前到那边。
lines.en: You change direction; I am already there.
You stop, I stop, quieter than you.

lines.zh: 我一直在缩短这点距离。
lines.en: I keep shortening that distance.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声暴露了全部。
lines.en: Your footsteps give away everything.

lines.zh: 你在屋里绕，我在屋里等。
lines.en: You loop the house; I wait inside it.
You hear wind; that is not wind.
I block your retreat first.
The more panicked you are, the straighter your path.

lines.zh: 我不用看，也能算到你在哪。
lines.en: I need not look to work out where you are.

lines.zh: 你和我的距离一直在缩。
lines.en: The gap between us keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，一直在你后面。
lines.en: I hug the wall, always behind you.

lines.zh: 你往后跳，我就往前一步。
lines.en: You jump back, and I take a step forward.

lines.zh: 我慢下来，是为了让你以为拉开了。
lines.en: I slow down so you think you have gained room.
Your hands shake, and you cannot run fast.
This path has only one end.
I hear you decide to go left.

lines.zh: 我从不喊，喊也没有意义。
lines.en: I never shout; there would be no point.
I catch you; I am simply too fast.
That blow spins you around.
My arms are long enough to reach.
I strike down from your side.

lines.zh: 你挡了，可我的手从下面来。
lines.en: You block, but my hand came from below.

lines.zh: 我的手比你反应快一步。
lines.en: My hand is a step faster than you.
That blow made almost no sound.
I clamp down on your breathing.
Your legs gave way, and that was me.

lines.zh: 我打完就退，你快追不上。
lines.en: I strike and withdraw too fast for you.
I grab the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 我一只手把你钉在门框。
lines.en: One hand pins you to the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我比 Anonymous 瘦，也更快。
lines.en: Thinner than Anonymous, and faster.

lines.zh: 这一下只是提醒你我在。
lines.en: That was only a reminder that I am here.

lines.zh: 我在你回头的那一瞬出现。
lines.en: I appear the instant you look back.
The air moves first, then I do.

lines.zh: 我从走廊尽头一步到了你面前。
lines.en: I cross the corridor in one step.

lines.zh: 屋子角落多了一条细长的影子。
lines.en: A thin shadow appears in the corner.
You feel a draught before you see me.
I arrive soundlessly.
I rise up in the doorway.
On your third count, I am there.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓一点点从暗处出来。
lines.en: My outline emerges from the dark bit by bit.
I appear behind you first.

lines.zh: 我站在你不是刚看过的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you just looked.

lines.zh: 地面抖了一下，我就在了。
lines.en: The ground shudders once, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我的头先出现，枝条一样。
lines.en: My head appears first, like a branch.
I hang down from the beam above.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很长的吸气。
lines.en: You hear one very long breath drawn in.

lines.zh: 我出现在你的视野边缘。
lines.en: I appear at the edge of your vision.

lines.zh: 我不用走过来，我已经在。
lines.en: I need not walk over; I am already here.

lines.zh: 我从另一侧绕到了前面。
lines.en: I have gone round the other side to your front.
A shadow grows from the corner first.

lines.zh: 你在的地方，现在也有我。
lines.en: Where you are, now I am too.
Fire stands before me and I go around it.

lines.zh: 我掉下来，落地时折了一下。
lines.en: I fall and fold on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的动作慢了。
lines.en: Water floods in and my movements slow.
The blast opens me up and I close again.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，我没停下。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in me and I do not stop.

lines.zh: 法术压住我，我扭着挣开。
lines.en: Magic pins me and I twist free.
It has been long since I caught anything.

lines.zh: 雷照亮我，我讨厌被看见。
lines.en: Lightning reveals me, and I hate being seen.

lines.zh: 虚空拖我，我的速度用不上了。
lines.en: The void pulls and my speed is useless.
